entities.summary: Carlos Moreno is a Franco-Colombian researcher, scientist, and professor at IAE – Paris 1 Sorbonne University. He co-founded the ETI chair "Entrepreneurship – Territory – Innovation" and has conducted research on smart and sustainable cities. He is mainly known for his contribution to the 15-minute city "Ville du quart d’heure" concept.
